dashboard_trackers.notes: No new verified Iranian enrichment, inspector-access, weaponization or safeguards threshold surfaced. Direct IAEA pages remained access-blocked, while UN and multi-source fallback review produced no technical status change. Raw 49; Iran-war coupling +7 => 56

dashboard_trackers.notes: UKMTO Advisory 096-26 records an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman; authorities are investigating. It reports no attack, damage, casualty or attribution. Mediated US-Iran contacts and constrained Gulf transit remain the wider context. Raw/coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Washington channel and the reported ceasefire remain the main constraints. No fresh Hezbollah strategic attack, mass-casualty event, or collapse of Israel-Lebanon contacts surfaced in the rolling review. Raw 81; Iran coupling +10 => 91

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified Turkish combat entry, force movement toward Iran, official nuclear-doctrine shift, or long-range launch surfaced in the rolling 24-hour review. Raw/coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Newly indexed Kargil and security-doctrine material was retrospective. No fresh Line of Control exchange, Indian force movement, or India-Pakistan strike was verified. Raw/coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Tank district bombing and Taliban rebuttal to Pakistani accusations remain the main items. No fresh Pakistan-Afghanistan state-on-state border strike, crossing closure, or sustained interstate clash was verified. Raw/coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Ukraine reported strikes on the Tyumen refinery, a Russian warship and vessels it says support Iran-linked military cargoes; reporting also describes a refinery fire. These expand the active war's geographic and infrastructure footprint but do not establish direct NATO entry or a nuclear-posture change. Raw/coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania's confirmed second drone shootdown remains under investigation and Allied coordination continues. No attribution for the second drone, third incursion, casualty or NATO consultation step surfaced after the prior review. Raw 51; Russia-Ukraine coupling +10 => 61

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new Taiwan quarantine, blockade declaration, amphibious mobilization, or military clash surfaced; current reporting remained preparedness and policy material. Raw 24; North Korea coupling +4 => 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reporting about possible KN-23 transfers to Russia remains a single claim chain. No fresh DPRK launch, atomic detonation, or major Korean Peninsula force movement surfaced. Raw/coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: North Kordofan and El Obeid danger remain acute, but no newer strategic advance around El Obeid, el-Fasher, or Port Sudan surfaced after the prior review. Raw/coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reporting continues to put West Bank detentions above 70 after the deadly clash, alongside raids, movement restrictions and settlement pressure. Later items were follow-ups or images of the same operation, not a distinct new escalation threshold. Raw/coupled 96

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: Regional reporting continued to discuss Sudan-South Sudan contacts and election risk, but no fresh military clash, verified large force movement, or Abyei security shift surfaced. Raw/coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: Renewed M23-Wazalendo clashes and documented reinforcement remain the latest threshold. No independent confirmation of the claimed mass recruitment, new strategic capture, or direct Rwanda-DRC clash surfaced. Raw/coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Post-15Z reports repeat the already-counted Houthi attacks on Saudi oil sites and Saudi-backed/Yemeni strikes on Houthi launch sites and depots. No distinct additional strike, verified refinery outage or new casualty total surfaced. Raw/coupled 84

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Bellingcat's geolocation of Shahed-type attacks and likely Russian support remains the latest threshold. No new casualty toll, confirmed operator identity, or strategic JNIM seizure surfaced. Raw/coupled 39

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh indexing still describes the already-counted second straight day and third faceoff of the week, not a distinct fourth encounter. No casualty, vessel loss, or treaty consultation surfaced. Raw/coupled 27
